picks.editorial_note: Operation Blue Skies is a landmark, government-backed and Google-led trial using AI to adjust flight paths and cut aviation's contrail-driven climate impact — a rare case of AI research moving directly into real-world climate mitigation at scale.
picks.title: World’s first trial to test if flightpath changes could cut aviation’s climate impact

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's role in over $42 million of NSF Integrated Data Systems and Services grants underpins national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure, a foundational investment that will shape research capacity well beyond one campus.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: A Johns Hopkins–Toyota Research Institute partnership pairs AI with high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate discovery of new battery materials, directly tying academic AI research to next-generation energy technology.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: MIT Lincoln Laboratory's ARCADE agentic AI system is being integrated into live U.S. Air Force combat aircraft operations, marking a significant real-world deployment of AI in national defense decision-making.
picks.title: Human–AI mission debrief enters the Air Force through ARCADE

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's computational infrastructure for the MOSAIC multi-modal microscope solves a major data-management bottleneck for combining diverse imaging techniques, enabling scientific insights that no single instrument could produce alone.
picks.title: Building the Computational Mind for the “Swiss Army Knife” of Microscopes

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that outputs from large generative AI models often can't be traced to specific training data — has significant implications for AI copyright, transparency, and accountability debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: A Kent State researcher's DOE Genesis Mission award to mine 50 years of river data for critical minerals like copper and cobalt shows AI directly supporting U.S. supply-chain and resource security priorities.
picks.title: Kent State Researcher Selected for US Department of Energy Genesis Mission Award to Mine Decades of River Data for Critical Minerals; Kent State Today; July 29, 2026

picks.editorial_note: A new five-year Imperial College London–Smith+Nephew center aims to translate academic computer-vision research into surgical robotics products, bridging AI research and clinical practice.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: Tohoku University and Western Digital's new joint lab targets next-generation data storage for AI workloads, addressing an infrastructure bottleneck that underlies the broader AI research and industry ecosystem.
picks.title: Tohoku University Launches AI Data Infrastructure Lab with Western Digital Corporation

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's move to require AI competency coursework across every undergraduate degree makes it one of the first major universities to embed AI literacy institution-wide, a notable policy shift in higher education.
picks.title: Purdue’s AI competency graduation requirement begins in every undergraduate degree program
